help.title: Help centre
help.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions.
help.contactText: Our team answers your requests in your account, with your order details at hand.

delivery.a1: Standard delivery targets 24 hours and DOOM EXPRESS targets 6 hours, depending on how your zone is configured. The exact estimate is shown at checkout before you pay; an option that is not configured for your area is shown as unavailable.
delivery.q2: How is the delivery fee calculated?
delivery.a2: From the rates configured for your zone (governorate or wilaya), the weight and volume of the parcel and the delivery type. The fee is always displayed before payment — never added afterwards.
delivery.a3: When your order is out for delivery, a 6-digit code appears on the order page and in your notifications. Give it to the courier only once you have the parcel in hand: it confirms the delivery.
delivery.q4: Can I change my delivery address?
delivery.a4: Before the order is handed to a courier, contact support from the order page. Once it is out for delivery, the address can no longer be changed.

payments.a1: DOOM Wallet, bank cards, Ooredoo, Omantel, crypto-assets and gift cards. Methods that are not activated yet are shown as unavailable at checkout and cannot be selected.
payments.a2: Only after confirmation by the payment provider or, for gift cards, after our finance team has verified the value actually received. Until then your order shows a pending payment.
payments.a3: Approved refunds are credited to your DOOM Wallet, or to the original payment method when the provider supports it. You can follow the status on the order page.

flex.a1: Pay in 3, 6 or 12 monthly instalments with 0% interest and no fees: the total equals the cash price.
flex.a2: Customers whose identity is verified. Each application is reviewed before approval.
flex.q3: How do I verify my identity?
flex.a3: In Account → Identity verification: confirm your details, photograph the front and back of your ID card and take a selfie. Files are encrypted and only authorised reviewers can open them.

returns.q1: How do I request a return?
returns.a1: Open a support request from the order page, explain the reason and add photos if the item is damaged.
returns.a2: Returned items are inspected for condition and completeness. The conditions are described in our returns policy.

warranty.a1: The warranty period is shown on each product page and on your receipt when the manufacturer or seller provides one.
warranty.q2: How do I make a warranty claim?
warranty.a2: Contact support with your order number and a description of the fault; we guide you through the manufacturer's procedure.

account.q1: How do I keep my account secure?
account.a1: Use a strong, unique password, review your active sessions in Account → Security and sign out of any device you don't recognise.
account.q2: How do I delete my account?
account.a2: Request it in Account → Security. Records we must keep by law (invoices, payment records) are retained for the legal period; the rest of your personal data is deleted.
